summary: Tested 2 new features via Playwright on live preview URL: (1) Suppliers page '+ Add Supplier' searchable Popover+Command combobox, (2) BOM Explorer drawing/documentation link (pink file icon). Both fully working. Ran regression smoke checks on purchasing-plan, production-plan, inventory, admin/sap-write - all load cleanly with zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: SuppliersPage.js: getRecommendedSuppliers() correctly excludes already-allocated suppliers from both 'recommended' and 'others' buckets via alreadyIn Set - confirmed HAMIDI EXPORTS (already in table for 100534-405) does not appear in the Add Supplier popover options.

addAllocationRow() immediately mutates quotaAllocations state and calls setAddSupplierPickerOpen(false) - matches the no-confirm-button UX requirement; verified popover closes automatically on selection.

BomExplorerPage.js collectAllProductIds() correctly walks the full tree (parents + leaves) unlike collectAllItems() (leaf-only) - appropriate since drawing links can exist on any Material master node, not just leaves.
loadDrawingUrls() has proper error swallowing (silent catch) since it's a non-critical, best-effort enrichment call - correct design given partial cache coverage.
Drawing link anchor correctly uses onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} to prevent triggering the parent row's expand/collapse toggle when clicking the icon - good defensive UX.

Suppliers page: loaded 100534-405, clicked 'open-add-quota-supplier-button', popover with search input opened, typed 'EXPO' -> list filtered live to ~20 matching names, confirmed HAMIDI EXPORTS (already allocated) absent from any search result. rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found. Only test-script friction: initial Playwright click on a Command/cmdk option inside the Popover threw 'Element is outside of the viewport' because the Add Supplier button sits far down the page and Playwright's implicit scroll didn't fully bring the popover's absolutely-positioned content into the viewport; fixed by explicitly scrolling the trigger button into view via page.evaluate(scrollIntoView) before opening the popover. This is a test-script issue only, not an application defect.
